title: Ranks and integer points on elliptic curves induced by Fibonacci triples
summary: Let $F_n$ and $L_n$ denote the Fibonacci and Lucas numbers, respectively, and consider \[ E_k:\qquad y^2=(F_{2k}x+1)(F_{2k+2}x+1)(F_{2k+4}x+1). \] These elliptic curves arise naturally from the regular Diophantine triples \[ \{F_{2k},F_{2k+2},F_{2k+4}\}. \] For odd $k$, we exhibit the rational point \[ Q_k=\left( -\frac{F_{k-1}}{L_kF_{k+1}F_{k+2}}, \frac{F_{2k+1}}{L_kF_{k+1}F_{k+2}} \right). \] For every odd $k\geq 3$, this point is independent of the standard point $P_k=(0,1)$; in particular, $\operatorname{rank}E_k(\mathbb{Q})\geq 2$.
